text: 1100-g (2-lb 7-oz) newborn, 31 weeks' gestation. The patient was born three days ago with a birth weight of 1100 g at 31 weeks' gestation. speaker: Doctor
text: The cranial ultrasound showing intraventricular hemorrhage is concerning, but given the chorioamnionitis and elevated CRP, I need to confirm if the lumbar puncture has been successfully performed and what the cerebrospinal fluid analysis revealed. text: Given the high suspicion of neonatal sepsis and meningitis with delayed lumbar puncture, I am proceeding with immediate empiric treatment while awaiting further diagnostics. REQUEST TEST: CSF Gram Stain, Culture, and Glucose Level. DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Meningitis.
